svg.title: A scaffold for comparing shoe friction
svg.desc: Shoe comparison scaffold: change shoe; keep the floor, total shoe-plus-load mass and pulling method the same; measure steady pulling force using a force meter; repeat three trials per shoe. Adult checks the meter and secures added loads.

g.text: A scaffold for comparing shoe friction
Floor, total shoe-plus-load mass, pulling method
Steady pulling force using a force meter
Three separate trials for each shoe
Adult checks meter and secures added loads
Tabletop/floor model only: no slipping or road-safety test.
